label: scam
title: Fake grandchild -- hospital, courier cash pickup

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Grandma? It's your grandson. I'm hurt, I'm in the hospital.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please don't tell Mom, I don't want her to worry.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I need $2,000 for the treatment. A courier will come to your door to pick up the cash in an hour.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Have it ready and don't mention this to anyone.
